mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Lock an object before changing it and get its lock handle.

description: Lock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*). Answers the lock_handle; a SERVICE_BINDING open in an editing session answers an empty one, under which its publication runs. Over Streamable HTTP the answer also carries the state_handle of the instance that holds the lock: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under this lock, the write and the unlock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header). When object_type is one of CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING; or object_type is PACKAGE and the connection is HTTP, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING.

name: HandlerLock
